[NLFC.9.1] **When to seed: at setup, before the first stream event.** After
creating an engine ([NLFC.1]) and before the engine emits its first stream
event, the integrator may seed the engine-owned cache with
`ds_engine_cache_seed` ([IARC.12]) — one call per entry — to restore a cache
snapshot persisted by the write-through hooks ([NSTG.9]). The window is a
load's ([NFCT.1.1]): a host assert, a retract and a pump ([NLFC.2]) each emit a
stream event, so a seed comes before the first of them, and a load or a seed
emits none. A seed establishes starting state, not a running-phase input, and
every seed is made before an encoder writes the head of the engine's stream
([RFCS.5.1]).
